update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.24 - Cross-run insights, auto-abandon, live decision panel
Added ----- - Cross-Run Insights. A new panel on Training Settings (the trend button next to the auto-tune wand) analyzes your whole career-run archive and surfaces patterns a single run can't show: which stat actually drives your final rank, what your best runs carry more of, which races you keep losing, and your rating trend and consistency. Optionally scoped to one scenario. - Auto-Abandon doomed runs. For unattended farming: once the live rank projection says a run will finish below your target grade (after a configurable trust turn), the bot stops the run so you can restart on a fresher one. Off by default; set the target grade and minimum turn in Training Settings. - Live "why this training" panel. The Remote Log Viewer's decision panel now updates every turn from a structured feed: the scoring mode, every candidate training's score with the pick flagged, and the key factors behind the choice.
Fixed ----- - The weekly game-data scraper no longer aborts the whole refresh when Game8 changes its skill tier-list page layout; the tier list is skipped gracefully and the rest of the data still updates.
